'''''Blood Oath''''' was a novel set to be written by [[Elaine Cunningham]] for [[Lucasfilm]] and [[Del Rey]], with an original release date of [[April]] [[2009]]. It would star the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Zekk]] encountering adventure, romance and [[Politics/Legends|political]] intrigue in the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Due to a prolonged sickness, however, Cunningham was unable to complete the book or submit a manuscript. After several deadline extensions, the book was ultimately canceled.

Set in [[41 ABY]], the novel would have featured Zekk encountering a [[Unidentified pirate captain (Zekk)|pirate captain]], being sent on a mission by [[Hapan]] [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], and teaming up with Djo's cousins [[Trista Zel|Trista]] and [[Taryn Zel]] to halt a brewing conflict. [[Jagged Fel]], the newly-appointed [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], would have been the focus of another plot that dealt with him settling into his role. However, ''Blood Oath''{{'s}} cancellation rendered its events non-[[canon]].
